title: Frozen pizza
question: How do you pick a frozen pizza?
decision: Frozen pizza with a short crust list: flour, water, salt, yeast.
why: Traditionally, Neapolitan dough holds only flour, water, salt and yeast.
short_answer: Read the crust list first. Traditionally, Neapolitan dough holds only flour, water, salt and yeast. A crust sold as whole wheat should list whole wheat flour, not plain wheat flour.
detail: Traditionally, Neapolitan dough is made only of flour, water, salt and yeast. The flour is 00 flour, a soft wheat flour of medium strength. The dough rises at least 8 hours, in two phases. Dough balls run 180 to 250 g. They are stretched by hand only, never pressed by machine or rolled with a pin. The finished pizza is no wider than 35 cm. Leftover dough balls are thrown out each evening. The pizza bakes on the floor of a wood oven at 430 to 485°C, for 60 to 90 seconds. The wood must give off no smoke or odor: oak, ash, beech and maple. Well baked means golden and unburnt, with a bread-scented rim and a soft center that folds without breaking. “Verace Pizza Napoletana” is a collective mark, a name its own association governs. It is not a DOP, the Italian protected name given only to first-stage foods such as cheese and oil. Ready pizzas and frozen dough balls are spreading today. On a US label, “pan style” means a pizza marketed in a pan with a thick crust. “Sicilian style” means a thick crust, usually 50 percent or more of the pizza.
kristy_take: The short crust list is the standard here. Traditionally, Neapolitan dough holds only flour, water, salt and yeast.
cart_pick: A pizza with a short crust list
buying_tips: Read the crust list for flour, water, salt and yeast.
On a whole wheat crust, look for whole wheat flour listed first.
At home, double-wrap a pizza for the freezer: plastic wrap, then foil.
Air touching the surface leaves freezer burn, grayish-brown leathery spots.
watch_out: A meat named on the box sets no minimum amount of that meat.

labels_decoded.meaning: Plain flour, with the bran and germ removed. It is not a whole grain flour.
A whole grain flour. FDA draft advice: a crust sold as whole wheat uses it throughout.
A pizza named for a meat topping needs no minimum amount of that meat.
Named on the label when a pizza holds less than one part cheese to nine parts cheese substitute.

tier_note: A whole wheat crust uses whole wheat flour, not plain wheat flour.
